# Silvana Montoya Noguera

###### He assumed leadership of the specialization in Soil Mechanics and Foundations

- [Start](https://www.eafit.edu.co/)
- [Institutional Information EAFIT University](https://www.eafit.edu.co/institucional)
- [Institutional Communications](https://www.eafit.edu.co/institucional/comunicados-institucionales)
- [Press Releases 2025](https://www.eafit.edu.co/institucional/comunicados-institucionales/comunicados-2025)
- Silvana Montoya Noguera assumed the leadership of the Specialization in Soil Mechanics and Foundations

[![Image by Silvana Montoya](https://universidadeafit.widen.net/content/720d8158-6ae6-4e03-b8e0-8491e7e0a482/web/Silvana-Montoya.jpg)](https://www.eafit.edu.co/institucional/comunicados-institucionales/comunicados-2025/silvana-montoya-noguera-asumio-la-jefatura-d-e-la-especializacion-en-mecanica-de-suelos-y)

![](https://www.eafit.edu.co/institucional/comunicados-institucionales/comunicados-2025/silvana-montoya-noguera-asumio-la-jefatura-d-e-la-especializacion-en-mecanica-de-suelos-y)

"This specialization focuses on providing a foundation and stability to connect our cities and territories. With my feet on the ground and high expectations for transformation, I assume this role and thank my colleagues and superiors who trust in me."

**Silvana Montoya Noguera.**

The School of Applied Sciences and Engineering announces that, as of March 17, 2025, Silvana Montoya Noguera assumed the position of head of the specialization in Soil Mechanics and Foundations, replacing Julián Vidal Valencia, who will continue his activities as a lecturer at the School of Applied Sciences and Engineering.

Silvana holds a PhD in Geotechnical Seismic Engineering from Paris-Saclay University; a Master's degree in Soil and Rock Mechanics from the National School of Bridges and Roads; and a degree in Civil Engineering from the University of the Andes.

She has been affiliated with EAFIT University as a full-time professor and researcher for approximately eight years and is part of the Nature and City research group. During this time, she has served as coordinator of the PhD program in Engineering and as a faculty representative on the former Research Committee.

She is currently the secretary of the Geotechnical Threats and Risks Commission in the Colombian Geotechnical Society; the national representative in the technical commission for Geotechnical Education of the ISSMGE; and the representative of EAFIT and ACOFI in the Latin American Open Chair Matilda and Women in Engineering.

His academic and research interests include the assessment of natural hazards and risks (such as earthquakes and landslides), soil-structure interaction, and variability and uncertainty in soil characterization.

We thank Julián for his commitment in this position. Likewise, we welcome Silvana to this position and wish her much success in her new role as head of the specialization, where her knowledge, experience, dedication, and commitment will be essential.

Sincerely,

**Ricardo Taborda Ríos,**

**Dean of the School of Applied Sciences and Engineering**

Press Release No. 15

Medellín, April 8, 2025
